page.layout: One column of dictionary entries, each headed by a large Hebrew word at the left. No margin notes. Running head centred at top, page number at top left. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: אלו[?] Chald. Ecce, Dan.2.3.1. ואלו Et ecce, Dan.7.8. idem quod ארו, de quo infrà suo loco, per commutationem ר & ל.
אלח Niph. נאלח Foetidus, Putidus, Rancidus factus fuit; Praet. נאלחו Putidi facti sunt, Psal.14. v.3. Partic. נאלח Foetidus factus est, Job.15.16.
אלך Chald. m. Illi, Isti. Pronomen Plur. masc. גבריא אלך Viri isti, Dan.3.12.

אלל אליל m. Nihilum, Res nihili: רפאי אלל Medici nihili; Job.13.4. ubi R. Levi notat, esse deductum ab אל Non, geminatâ litera Lamed, ad extremam nullitatem indicandam: ואלול Et re nihili, Jer.14.14. scribitur cum ו, & legitur per': Plur. אלילים Idola, Lev.26.1. sic dicta, quòd sint omninò Nihil, juxta illud Apostoli: Idolum enim nihil est. Quidam sic dicta putant, quasi אל אלים Non dii. Constr. אלילי Jes.2. v.20. Aff. ואלילה Et idolis ejus, Jes.10.11.
אלול m. Elul, nomen mensis Augusti, Neh.6.15.

אלם Niph. נאלם Mutus redditus fuit, Obmutuit. Praet. נאלמתי Obmutui, Ps.39.10. Fut. תאלם Obmutescas, Ezech.24.27. Pih. אלם Ligare, Colligare, proprie manipulus vel fasces segetum, significatione à nomine derivato petitâ: Particip. מאלמים אלמים Colligantes segetum fasces, q.d. Manipulantes manipulos; Genes.37.7.

אלם m. Manipulus, id est, קהל Congregatio, Caterva, ut Ab. Esra citat, Psal.58.2. Item, על יונת אלם De oppressione manipuli, quâ scil. justum opprimit manipulus malignus, Psal.46.1. Alii, De columba obmutescentia.
אלם m. Mutus, Exod.4.11. Plur. אלמים Jes.56.10.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points are largely omitted; consonants are copied as seen. Headword at the top (אלו) is uncertain and marked. Page number "31" is partly legible. Some Hebrew forms in the entries (for example נאלמתי, תאלם, מאלמים) were read from a small scan and may contain errors. Latin italic runs are approximate where the scan is faint.
